{{Quote|That's the ''Brassbound'', I think. Probably chasing after General Grievous' secret weapon everyone's talking about.''"<br />"''Hmmph.|Clone troopers Rys and Jek|<ref name="TCW:P" />}}
The '''''Brassbound''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the ''Brassbound'' was situated in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Drydock/Legends|drydocks]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when it and several other [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] were sent off to fight the growing [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] threat in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. The ''Brassbound''{{'s}} departure from Coruscant was noted by a pair of [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]], [[Rys/Legends|Rys]] and [[Jek/Legends|Jek]].

==Description==
Built by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]],<ref name="Databank" /> the ''Brassbound'' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that was part of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TCW:P" /> At 1,137 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, the ''Brassbound'' had an armament of fifty-two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], eight [[DBY-827 heavy turbolaser turret/Legends|DBY-827 heavy dual turbolaser turrets]], two medium dual [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannons, four [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedos]] tubes, and six [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projectors.<ref name="Databank" />

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="swannual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> the ''Brassbound'' was stationed at the Republic's [[Drydock/Legends|drydocks]] on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when it was dispatched to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] with several other [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] to fight the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. The departure of the ''Brassbound'' from the drydocks was noticed by a pair of [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]] nicknamed [[Rys/Legends|Rys]] and [[Jek/Legends|Jek]], who were staying at the nearby [[Republic Service Organization center]], awaiting their next mission.<ref name="TCW:P" />

As the ''Brassbound'' lifted from the docks, Rys speculated that the Star Destroyer was being sent off to hunt for Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and his new secret weapon<ref name="TCW:P" />&mdash;the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>&mdash;which had recently begun ambushing Republic [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TCWRising">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Brassbound''{{'s}} only appearance in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] was a small cameo in the [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] ''[[The Clone Wars: Prelude]]'', posted on [[StarWars.com]] on [[October 2]], [[2008]]. The Star Destroyer was briefly seen in the background of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic's]] second-to-last page.
